lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Why does every payment screen ask you for a *tip* now?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The answer hides in three little buttons, and it is *smarter* than it looks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In a big 2023 survey, seventy two percent of Americans said tipping is expected in *more* places now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Food trucks ask, coffee counters ask, and even some self-checkout machines *ask*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So you order a six dollar coffee, and the screen turns round to *face* you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It offers you a tip of twenty, twenty five or *thirty* percent.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Most of us assume those buttons are simply the *normal* amounts.
